title: Gradius
blurb: Horizontal shooter. Stage 1 plays and is audible: the Vic Viper, the Options, the terrain, the enemies and their bullets, the weapons, the power-up meter and the $ED02 sound driver, verified frame-exact against the cartridge.

display.frameHzNote: NES NTSC with rendering ENABLED: PPU 5369318.18 Hz / 89341.5 (frames alternate 89342/89341 -- one cycle is skipped on the pre-render line of odd frames). Blanked, it is 60.098478. Derived, not rounded -- see docs/knowledge/07.

input.note: The $0007 (held) / $0005 (edge) bit layout, MEASURED by A/B RAM diff -- see tools/oracle/PROBE.md 4 and BTN in src/state.js, which this must equal (tests/input.test.js asserts it). The low nibble is direction: `AND #$0F` at $A082 is the ROM's own test for 'any direction held'.

touchLayout.note: The on-screen pad in index.html. The d-pad is ONE pointer-capture surface hit-tested as a 3x3 grid, not four buttons: the corner cells report TWO bits, because updatePlayer() tests X and Y independently and a diagonal is nothing but two bits at once. The cluster is SELECT+START stacked ABOVE B+A -- inline with A/B the row is wider than the space beside the d-pad and A falls off a narrow phone (learned on the Game Boy port).
